title: leptodactylon pungens subsp. hazeliae
intro: Leptodactylon pungens subsp. hazeliae, commonly known as Hazelia, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hazelia plant include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-diabetic properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Leptodactylon pungens subsp. hazeliae include essential oils, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
